name: Leap
blurb: Determine whether a given year is a leap year.
instructions:
# Instructions

Your task is to determine whether a given year is a leap year.
introduction:
# Introduction

A leap year (in the Gregorian calendar) occurs:

- In every year that is evenly divisible by 4.
- Unless the year is evenly divisible by 100, in which case it's only a leap year if the year is also evenly divisible by 400.

Some examples:

- 1997 was not a leap year as it's not divisible by 4.
- 1900 was not a leap year as it's not divisible by 400.
- 2000 was a leap year!

~~~~exercism/note
For a delightful, four-minute explanation of the whole phenomenon of leap years, check out [this YouTube video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xX96xng7sAE).
~~~~
hints:
# Hints

## General

- You may want to look at the `Nat.mod` function in the `base` standard library to accomplish this.
- Enter `docs Nat.mod` in the UCM or navigate to read about the behavior of `Nat.mod` or navigate to [the documentation for the function online at Unison Share](https://share.unison-lang.org/@unison/code/latest/namespaces/public/base/latest/;/terms/Nat/mod)

example_solution:
leap : Nat -> Boolean
leap year =
  isFactor a b =
    (Nat.mod a b) === 0
  (isFactor year 4 && (not (isFactor year 100 ) || isFactor year 400 ))
test_code:
leap.test.t1 = verify do
  labeled "leap should be false when year is not divisible by 4" do
    expected = false
    actual = leap 2015
    ensureEqual expected actual

leap.test.t2 = verify do
  labeled "leap should be false when year is divisible by 2 not divisible by 4" do
    expected = false
    actual = leap 1970
    ensureEqual expected actual

leap.test.t3 = verify do
  labeled "leap should be true when year is divisible by 4" do
    expected = true
    actual = leap 1964
    ensureEqual expected actual

leap.test.t4 = verify do
  labeled "leap should be true when year divisible by 4, not divisible by 100" do
    expected = true
    actual = leap 1996
    ensureEqual expected actual

leap.test.t5 = verify do
  labeled "leap should be true when year divisible by 4 and 5" do
    expected = true
    actual = leap 1960
    ensureEqual expected actual

leap.test.t6 = verify do
  labeled "leap should be false when year divisible by 100, not divisible by 400" do
    expected = false
    actual = leap 2100
    ensureEqual expected actual

leap.test.t7 = verify do
  labeled "leap should be true when year divisible by 400 and 100" do
    expected = true
    actual = leap 2000
    ensureEqual expected actual

leap.test.t8 = verify do
  labeled "leap should be false when year divisible by 4 and 100" do
    expected = false
    actual = leap 1900
    ensureEqual expected actual

leap.test.t9 = verify do
  labeled "leap should be false when year divisible by 200, not divisble by 400" do
    expected = false
    actual = leap 1800
    ensureEqual expected actual

test> leap.tests =
  join [
    leap.test.t1,
    leap.test.t2,
    leap.test.t3,
    leap.test.t4,
    leap.test.t5,
    leap.test.t6,
    leap.test.t7,
    leap.test.t8,
    leap.test.t9
  ]
